unsupported_note: We don't know this kind of thing yet, so check the title.
error_locale: That language tag doesn't look right.
error_pds: Couldn't save to your account. Try again.
docs_intro: A review is one thing, and the adjectives it is, or is not. It lives in the reviewer's own repo, so anyone can read it.
docs_record_note: at.isnot.review. One record per thing, holding as many adjectives as you like. The subject carries enough to show without fetching anything.
docs_use_read: Read them straight from repos, or follow the firehose for the collection.
docs_use_write: Write them with @is-not/lenses, which turns a record you already show into a review subject.
docs_use_show: Show them with @is-not/sentence, which turns a review into a sentence in the reader's language.
error_handle: That handle didn't resolve. Check it, or pick a service.
